claims.claim_text: Eleven years of continuous military operations and repeated deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan have stretched U.S. forces and strained their families.

Commitment to deter any adversary who would attack the U.S. or use terror as a tool of government.
The United States is interested in putting an end to al-Qaeda's safe havens.
Opposition to United States military intervention in the civil war in Syria.
Retention of all options in dealing with a situation that gravely threatens U.S. security, U.S. interests, and the safety of U.S. friends.
